name: CRACK machine: hybrid-rate snare / drum engine
description: One added machine: a hybrid-rate drum voice. Three sine modes with two pitch envelopes, a TPT-filtered noise snare with head-coupled rattle and clap bursts, a tuned comb ring, and a 24 kHz heat chain, with a full-rate click and air layer above 12 kHz. The four knobs are Wires, Body, Snap and Heat; PUNCH is a rimshot, GATE sustains, DECAY is the engine's own envelope time.

emulation.note: Engine cost = active six-voice block minus the same build idle six-voice block, divided by six. Worst = trig with all four knobs changing on that block (hard ceiling <=1.00 x TONE met; margin target 0.90 x not met). Steady = 0.851 x. Raw six-voice blocks: CRACK worst 78,295 / steady 74,409 / idle 46,010 vs TONE steady 33,356; the raw total includes the OS six-voice loop and is not the engine-code comparison. First note after a machine change costs 17,473/voice once (the OS still owns v+0x2c until the first trig, so the bridge resets the voice once).
